company.name: Darmiyan
company.shortDescription: Darmiyan has developed the first AI-powered software platform for early detection, monitoring, and stratification of Alzheimer's disease.
company.description: Darmiyan has developed a novel, proprietary, patent-protected technology called The Virtual Microscope (Software Algorithm). Using a non-invasive routine clinical brain MRI scan, The Virtual Microscope technology looks into the human brain and localizes and quantifies cell distortion (neurodegeneration) in every voxel of brain MRI generating new brain maps. The first clinical product of this technology is BrainSee, an AI-powered algorithm that has completed a successful third-party validation in the US and Canada establishing a remarkable accuracy and consistency for prognosis of mild cognitive impairment. It is built on over 40 years of cutting-edge neuroscience research combined with advanced medical image analysis and AI, and has received official approval from the late Prof. Paul Greengard, Nobel Laureate in Physiology/ Medicine 2000.

productsAndServices.description: A medical software that combines brain MRI and cognitive test scores to generate a score indicating the likelihood of progression from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer's dementia.
productsAndServices.name: BrainSee

productsAndServices.description: A virtual microscope that resolves tissue structure in every voxel of a brain MRI, providing detailed insights into brain tissue architecture.
